title: refactor(ci): consolidate workflows, upgrade actions, and release automation hygiene
author: Maya Thompson
description:
Motivation: our repository has accumulated several duplicated GitHub Actions workflows and slightly divergent lint/test/release steps across packages. This makes maintenance harder, increases CI minutes, and causes inconsistent release behavior. This PR consolidates lint/test/build/release workflows into a smaller set of shared workflow templates, upgrades key GitHub Actions to current recommended versions, and applies hygiene changes to reduce noise and flakiness.

What this PR does (summary):
- Consolidate multiple per-package workflows into centralized workflows: .github/workflows/lint.yml, test.yml, release.yml now use workflow templates and reusable jobs.
- Upgrade commonly used actions to supported versions (actions/checkout@v4, actions/setup-node@v4, actions/cache@v4).
- Standardize Node runtime matrix to node 18 and node 20 where required; use consistent cache keys.
- Add a shared CI helper (scripts/ci/checks.sh) to produce uniform annotations and exit codes.
- Add a lightweight dry-run step to release workflow to detect changelog and tag issues before performing real releases.
- Reduce duplicate job definitions and add concurrency groups to avoid overlapping release runs.
- Improve logs and error classification for flaky integration tests; add automatic rerun-on-failure for a target set of flaky suites.
- Update docs: docs/ci/README.md describes the new workflow structure and on-call guidance for CI failures.

Checklist:
- [x] Consolidate reusable workflows and update dependent repositories to reference templates
- [x] Upgrade GH Actions versions and runtime matrices
- [x] Add dry-run and guard rails to release automation
- [x] Add CI helper script and docs
- [x] Validate migration on fork and run full pipeline

Testing and validation performed:
- Ran full pipeline on fork (lint/test/integration) initially integration had two flaky failures; reran and passing after tuning timeouts and retries.
- Performed release dry-run against staging: validated changelog detection, tag creation logic, and permission scopes.
- Canary rollout: merged to a feature branch and exercised a few dependent repos referencing the reusable workflows to ensure no breakage.

Rollout notes:
- This PR is merged with a squash merge. Dependent repos using previous in-repo workflows should be migrated to reusable workflows. Migration guide in docs/ci/README.md.
- If you see unexpected release runs, check .github/release-config and the concurrency group names.

References: Linear ENG-1283 (CI consolidation), ENG-1309 (release automation hygiene).
